name: Levites
shortDescription: A UK-developed mobile-first church communication and volunteer-rotas platform for coordinating ministry teams, reminders, service schedules and team collaboration.
suitableContexts: Churches replacing ad-hoc WhatsApp groups and spreadsheets for serving teams
Ministry teams that need a native iPhone app for rota responses and communications
Churches that want a focused team-coordination layer rather than a full people database

pricing.summary: Levites describes free and paid workspace access. Its current App Store listing shows in-app purchases in US dollars, but this profile has not established a UK web price list, what each plan includes, billing route, VAT treatment or renewal terms. Ask the supplier for the full current UK commercial schedule in writing.

tiers.label: Workspace access
tiers.detail: Supplier says team limits and workspace tools may require an active plan or subscription; establish plan scope before purchase

dataHosting: The available supplier and App Store material does not establish Levites' hosting provider, storage location, sub-processors, backups, security controls or recovery commitments. Confirm these before placing member contact data, pastoral messages or rota information in the service.
gdprInformation: The App Store developer disclosure says that contact information, user content and usage data may be linked to a user, while identifiers and diagnostics may be collected without linkage. That disclosure is not a church-facing data-processing agreement. Obtain current UK GDPR terms covering controller and processor roles, sub-processors, access, retention, deletion, breach notification and export.
support: Supplier publishes a support route through the website
App Store listing provides developer support and website links

uk-purchasing.value: Levites Tech Ltd is active on the UK register under company number 17059524 and is classified for software development.

live-mobile-app.value: The App Store lists Levites as a church communication and rota app developed by Levites Tech Ltd, with version 1.0.10 released in July 2026.

pricing.value: The supplier says there are free and paid workspace options, while App Store purchases are currently displayed in USD; current UK plan scope and terms are not established in this profile.

data-processing.value: A church-facing data-processing agreement, hosting detail, sub-processor list and retention terms are not available in the reviewed public material.

migration.value: Import, export and exit-data arrangements are not available in the reviewed public material.

editorial.assessment: Levites is a focused, newly launched UK option for churches whose main problem is coordinating serving teams and their communications, rather than operating a full church-management database. Its recent native iPhone releases make it worth evaluating, but its public commercial, privacy and exit documentation is presently too limited for a church to assume operational suitability. A small pilot with non-sensitive rota data is the sensible first step.
bestFor: Church media, worship, welcome and service teams that need a simpler rota-and-communications workflow
Churches prioritising a native iPhone experience for serving-team coordination
Teams willing to pilot an early-stage product before broader operational use
strengths: Specific church communication and rota focus
Active UK software company and recent live App Store releases
Native mobile delivery with stated free and paid workspace routes
Potentially useful alternative to fragmented messaging and rota tools
limitations: Newly incorporated supplier and early product history require careful pilot evaluation
Establish current UK price schedule, VAT treatment, support arrangements and plan limits before purchase
Hosting, DPA, sub-processors, retention, data export and accessibility evidence are not available in this profile
It should not be treated as a complete people-records, finance, safeguarding or Gift Aid system

procurementVerdict.problem: Coordinating volunteer communications, availability and service rotas without scattered messages and spreadsheets
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK-built, mobile-first church team platform with a live native iPhone app
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Run a short non-sensitive team pilot, testing invitation, rota acceptance, reminder reliability, administrator controls and a requested export before moving church-wide communication
